title: SOC2 evidence scratchpad - Q1 audit prep
content:
Quick brain dump and running todo list for SOC2 evidence collection - personal scratchpad. Mostly shorthand, will formalize later.

Status summary:
- Kickoff meeting with auditor scheduled 2026-03-10 (Marta) - confirm scope: CC, IAAS, third-party vendors.
- Evidence tracker spreadsheet partially populated (see Confluence link). Need to map control IDs to evidence files.

Top priorities (by due date):
1) Access reviews: complete admin account list export + attestations (due 2026-03-05) - assigned to Marco.
   - Export from Okta: okta-admins-report-2026-02-28.csv (small gaps: svc-infra account missing last login)
   - TODO: follow up with infra team to confirm svc-infra justification (owner: Marco, due 2026-03-03)
2) Change management evidence: signed change log for infra infra-2025-Q4 -> infra-2026-Q1 (due 2026-03-08) - I will collect PR links and release notes.
   - Known gaps: automated deployments for private cluster not captured in ticketing for 2025-12. Need retrospective ticket.
3) Vendor reviews (third-party risk): complete vendor questionnaire for LLM-model-hosting partner (NebulaAI?) - due 2026-03-12.
   - Vendor docs to attach: vendor-security-summary.pdf, SOC2-type-2.pdf (if provided).
   - TODO: ask procurement for contract redactions (Priya)

Evidence locations (where to upload / file names to use):
- Drive folder: shared_drives/security-and-compliance/SOC2/2026/evidence (confirm perms)
- Okta exports: okta-admins-report-YYYY-MM-DD.csv (store encrypted)
- Jira proofs: put PR ids in evidence spreadsheet column "related_artifacts"

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we accept vendor's ISO reports in lieu of SOC2? Auditor asked for equivalence criteria. Action: ask Marta for acceptance threshold. (TODO 2026-03-04)
- Private deployment KMS key rotation logs: where are rotation events stored? I think key-ops team has a vault audit stream. Action: ping key-ops (Slack: #key-ops) and request last 12 months export. (Priya)
- Are we capturing emergency access exceptions? I have a handful of manual overrides documented in Confluence page but not all formal attestation. Need formal attestation collection from on-call leads.

Meeting notes (2026-02-25 sync with Marco + Priya):
- Marco: working on admin list, will add manual justification column for service accounts.
- Priya: procurement will surface NDA / vendor attachments by EOD 2026-02-27; will chase contract team for redactions.
- Evelyn: will draft evidence cover letters for each control group and start uploading to Drive.

Quick todo list (short, actionable):
- [ ] Follow up with infra re svc-infra account justification (Marco) - due 2026-03-03
- [ ] Export Okta full workstation and admin lists (Evelyn) - due 2026-03-04
- [ ] Request KMS rotation logs from key-ops (Priya) - due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Create retrospective ticket for 2025-12 private deploy change (Evelyn) - due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Vendor questionnaire: send to NebulaAI + set review meeting (Marco) - due 2026-03-09
- [ ] Draft control-group cover letter (access controls) and upload to evidence folder (Evelyn) - due 2026-03-07

Notes / snippets to paste into formal doc later:
- "Access control evidence set: Okta export (users + groups), role definitions (Confluence sec-roles page), admin attestations (signed spreadsheet), SSO config screenshots."
- "Change management evidence: PRs linked to Jira tickets, release notes, and change approvals recorded in release-engineering channel + release-review doc."
- "Vendor management: questionnaire, contract summary (redacted), penetration test reports, and SLA + incident response commitments."

Mini vendor review notes (NebulaAI):
- Received security-summary (2026-02-20) - missing encryption-at-rest details for model artifacts; asked vendor for clarification 2026-02-22.
- Outstanding: Does NebulaAI permit subprocessor list? Need to confirm.

Tags to keep in mind for final upload: access-controls, change-management, vendor-management, config-backups, monitoring-logs.

Random reminders:
- Keep filenames consistent: <control>-evidence-<yyyy-mm-dd>.<ext>
- When in doubt, include a 1-page cover note for an evidence bundle explaining scope and time range.

Later (notes to self):
- Build a checklist macro in Confluence that pulls evidence links (ask devops to expose links via API).
- Propose a quarterly evidence snapshot process to reduce scramble before audits.

References / links to paste into Confluence later:
- SEC-412 (Jira) - admin access review ticket
- https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+Checklist

-- end scratchpad --
